item.title: Bowman, Supervisory Modernization After Silicon Valley Bank

rating.summary: Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman delivered remarks at the Bangkok Economic Festival focused on supervisory modernization lessons from the 2023 Silicon Valley Bank failure. She discussed a newly commissioned independent review of SVB's collapse, reforms to Federal Reserve supervisory accountability and decision-making, and implications for international standard-setting bodies like the BCBS and FSB. The speech is entirely focused on bank supervision and regulatory reform rather than monetary policy.
rating.stance_rationale: This speech contains no discussion of interest rates, inflation, employment, or monetary policy tools. It is a supervisory and regulatory policy speech and is therefore not relevant to the dovish-hawkish monetary policy spectrum.
key_quotes: Modernization is not about doing less. It is about more effectively prioritizing the things that matter the most.
A central finding is that supervisors had information about SVB's major vulnerabilities many months before its failure but did not make appropriate use of it.
